annotations.text:
Click into the frame, then press Space to start.
Y = real word, N = not a word.

The prototype runs the real staircase from issue #4 on a small word bank (3k-a … 5k-b): 10 real + 5 invented words per block, score ≥ 0.85 moves up, stop on the 2nd reversal or 6 blocks.

Tweak "view" → "sample result" shows the result screen for the worked example without playing.
